---
name: create-instructions
description: This prompt is used to generate agent instructions .md files for the /docs directory.
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Take the information below and generate an agent instructions .md file for it in the /docs directory. If a .md filename is provided, use that, otherwise generate an appropriate filename based on the generated content. Make sure the instructions are concise and not too long. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to reference this new docs file. If no information is provided below, prompt the user to give the necessary details or coding standards to document. The generated instructions should be clear and actionable for developers working on this codebase.
